title.en: Tale 34 — The Neighbour Who Never Returns

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: The neighbour had an unpleasant habit.
He took things and did not return them.
He took a stick, and then a knife.
Juha gave and did not say anything.
He asked for the long rope.
He said: the rope is busy now.
The neighbour asked: busy with what?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אנחנו שמים עליו קמח.
sentences.en: Juha said: we are putting flour on it.
The neighbour shouted: flour on a rope?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: זה לא הגיוני בכלל.
sentences.en: He said: that is not sensible at all.
He said: it is really strange.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אבל אם לא רוצים לתת.
sentences.en: He said: but if one does not want to give.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אז הכול הגיוני מספיק.
sentences.en: He said: then everything is sensible enough.
